Issues.Message: Section A-A has a stepped cutting trace. The current backend supports only a planar X=0 section, so this offset section cannot be generated. The section is declared as offset and has not been flattened to X=0.
Issues.RecommendedAction: Keep the drawing as it is. Run the part again once the backend supports offset or stepped sections.

Issues.Message: The third hole is treated as absent only when both E and F are blank. Rows 11-30-200 and 11-30-92 have both blank, so the hole is absent. Row 11-30-381 has F=0 with E=14, so the hole is real and sits at position 0. The presentIfColumn is set to E, but the both-blank rule also depends on F.
Issues.RecommendedAction: Treat the third hole as absent only when both E and F are empty. Do not treat F=0 as absent.

Issues.Message: Excel values contain tolerance text such as Ø160±1, 88,9±0,5 and Ø10 (+0,1|-0,0), and use decimal commas. Geometry expressions need plain numeric values.
Issues.RecommendedAction: Yerel ayrıştırıcı bu dosyadaki nominal/tolerans biçimlerini başarıyla okudu. Bu model önerisi nedeniyle Excel sütunlarını ayırmayın.

Issues.Message: The drawing does not state that holes h1 and h2 are symmetric about the center. The expressions B/2 and -B/2 are used because B is the center distance between them and G is the offset from the center. The third hole X position (column F) and its exact sign are read from the stepped trace and view only.
Issues.RecommendedAction: Add explicit position columns for the holes if they are not symmetric. Where G equals half of B, the hole lies on the center.

Issues.Message: The green dimensions 33.0 (depth), R8 (outer radius) and 3 (thickness) are fixed across rows. All their annotations are hidden in the output.
Issues.RecommendedAction: Keep these values fixed and leave them without annotations.

Issues.Message: The camera direction is a visual approximation of the shaded view.
Issues.RecommendedAction: Use the approximated direction as the reference-matching view.

Issues.Message: Taslak kademeli/ofset kesit gerektiriyor; yeni OCCT çizim yolu yalnızca X=0 düzlemini destekliyor.
Issues.RecommendedAction: Yazılıma kademeli kesit desteği eklenmeli. Doğru girdiyi değiştirmek gerekli değildir.

Issues.Message: Şema v2 koşullu özellik yürütücüsü tamamlanmadı.
Issues.RecommendedAction: Yazılım desteği tamamlanmalı; boş hücreleri sıfırla doldurmayın.
